_comment: Facts about this adapter that its probe response cannot carry: display names, maturity, and the engine versions CI actually restores from. Everything the probe declares (adapter version, engine id, source kinds, pitr) is read from testdata/probe_response.golden instead — never duplicated here. The capabilities generator fails if the source names below do not match the probe exactly, and the integration suite restores from the images listed under verified — the baseline on every run, the rest in the scheduled version matrix and before a release tag — so neither can drift. The sandbox starts idle (command: sleep infinity) and the adapter starts taosd and taosadapter itself, pinned to loopback with TAOS_FQDN and TAOS_FIRST_EP because an image can carry a name that resolves to nothing here — 3.3.5.8 ships fqdn buildkitsandbox, the hostname of the machine that built it, and the engine refuses to start on it (measured from both sides). It starts the engine because the image's own entrypoint does not always finish: measured twice on CI's runners, on both images, the container's trace stops where the entrypoint reads its data directory and nothing else starts, while the same image serves in 0.6 s elsewhere. Readiness is a node the cluster reports ready rather than a query that answers: measured, SHOW DATABASES answers and SERVER_STATUS reads 1 at t+338 ms while CREATE DATABASE still fails with 'Out of dnodes', and the node reports ready at t+1006 ms, exactly when the create succeeds. Measured on both verified lines: the restore runs at 256 MiB, taosdump exits 0 whether it restored everything, half a damaged backup or nothing at all, and a 3.3.6.13 artifact restores into 3.3.5.8. TDengine publishes no end-of-life dates, so supported_until is null. See docs/capabilities.md and docs/engine-versions.md.
name: TDengine

sources.taosdump: One `taosdump` output directory, named at either level
sources.taosdump_dir: A directory of them; the newest by the dumps' own recorded instant is restored
sources.taosdump_tar: One tar archive of a taosdump output directory
